summary: Completed phases 1-3 of 8, sorry-free: R1 probe (CS5PairAxiom sound + cl-stable), atom-relabeling Derivable functoriality, and CS5PairAxiom library promotion (new CS5Completeness.lean). Phase 4 blocked: prime_exclusion needs orE for arbitrary mixed Atom-oplus-Atom formulas (Phase 3's axiom set is too narrow), and even fixed, the seed-exclusion step needs an unproven context-relative conservativity theorem (R2) that turns out load-bearing here, not just at Phase 5 as planned.

blockers.description: Phase 4 (combined-theory primeness via prime_exclusion, excluding {tauL(box A), tauR A}) needs a context-relative conservativity lemma (CS5PairAxiom-derivability from a two-sided seed reduces to CS5ModalAxiom-derivability per side) to show the seed doesn't already derive the excluded formulas. This is plausible (sketch recorded in the plan's Phase 4 blocker section, using CS5ModalAxiom.tBox / box-B-implies-B) but unproven and substantial -- comparable in difficulty to the original box-backward obstruction. Semantic and signature-collapse routes were tried and ruled out.

decisions_made: CS5Completeness.lean created as a new file, separate from CS5Canonical.lean's unrelated birelational route
Phase 2's per-side CS5PairAxiom specialisation deferred to Phase 3 (CS5PairAxiom did not exist yet in Phase 2)
dead_ends: Semantic (cs5PairAxiom_sound) route for seed-exclusion: circular, presupposes the truth lemma being built
Signature-collapse via Sum.elim id id retraction: cross1's image is box B to B, not a CS5ModalAxiom instance, so the retraction is not schema-compatible
